title: PM-JAY packages for govt hospitals: 23 to 112
takeaways: 89 packages proposed for government-only treatment, from 1 Dec 2026.
11.69 crore admissions authorised; 6.74 crore in private hospitals.
Out-of-pocket health spending down from 64% to 42%.
source_note: Sources: NHA via ANI; PIB Lok Sabha replies; ETV Bharat; PTI
